full_name: Mikhail Tikhonov | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Physical Sciences Shutzer Fellow Washington University in St. Louis
bio: Mikhail Tikhonov is a theoretical physicist and associate professor at Washington University in St. Louis who works at the intersection of statistical physics and high-diversity ecology.
